title: kb_http read_chunked lets chunk framing grow without bound, so a 1-byte-chunk flood is read at about 31 times --max-body
goal: kb_http.Handler.read_chunked caps the total framing allowance (e.g. CHUNK_SLACK plus at most the limit), so a body of 1-byte chunks with short extensions whose framing runs far past --max-body gets 413 and a refused body's drain stays near DRAIN, while a body at --max-body in 256-byte chunks is still served; test_kb_http plants a 1-byte-chunk flood with short extensions, and test_kb_http_chunk_extensions_capped's docstring says what the allowance is; found by the SP-3siaqxdf review of BG-zd6wok57 (kb_http.py:197 adds CHUNK_FRAME per chunk with no cap)
